body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING SPECIAL REPORT ON 'CES 2013') - Codeline (President, Jang wook ki, www.codeline.kr) unveiled its enlgish education mobile application 'Easy&Elly Ep1' with 3D character based, at the world's largest consumer electronics exhibition 'CES 2013' .

'Easy&Elly Ep1' is a mobile content that leads two way communication between users and character with 3D character and contents based. It consists of coloring with characters in animation, and learning contents that lead kids to learn and study with more fun.

The main characters in this animation consist of high and mighty character, 'Easy', and gentle & wise character 'Elly'. Although Easy is accused of his bossy and fussy personality, he overcomes it with his optimism. 'Easy&Elly Ep1' leads users to experience 'Easy' character indirectly by suggesting wrong answers if the user is with a superficial knowledge in that specific field.
'Elly' character used to be a loner, so she values her new friend 'Esay' very much. She plays role as a leader and instructs 'Easy' to the right way and helps to find him a solution.
